name: john sanfey
abstract: Without a formal relationship to physical laws, consciousness cannot cause observable outcomes. It is shown here that when consciousness is defined as experiencing simultaneity with temporally extended sensory patterns in continuous time, the problem becomes identical to a foundational problem in physics, that of quantum-classical incompatibility. Classical and quantum physics use incompatible frameworks for modelling how causal history influences motion during instants of continuous time. Both
notable: Published in Frontiers in Psychology (2023); MD from Trinity College Dublin
